name: JAC Japan map 15 km (historical): 1534 relations, 8 start alliances (incl. Shimazu-Ryukyu) sharing vision, then lapsed by the 30-turn alliance limit and not re-made, feud opinion penalty (-10, both ways); OUCHI human (largest house, as in japan-prosperous-15km)

steps.code: local id={}; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local f=string.match(PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName(),'^CIVILIZATION_JAC_(.+)$'); if f then id[f]=p:GetID() end end; for _,f in ipairs({'OUCHI','OTOMO','HOJO','IMAGAWA','MORI','DATE','ASHINA','ASHIKAGA','ROKKAKU','TAKEDA','ODA','SHIMAZU','RYUKYU','NAGAO','YAMANOUCHI_UESUGI','MATSUDAIRA','HONGANJI'}) do if id[f]==nil then error('missing faction '..f) end end; local majors=PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors(); local pairs_n=0; for _,a in ipairs(majors) do for _,b in ipairs(majors) do if a:GetID()~=b:GetID() then pairs_n=pairs_n+1; local d=a:GetDiplomacy(); if not d:HasMet(b:GetID()) then error(a:GetID()..' has not met '..b:GetID()) end; if d:GetVisibilityOn(b:GetID())<1 then error(a:GetID()..' access level on '..b:GetID()..' is below Limited') end end end end; if pairs_n~=#majors*(#majors-1) or #majors~=22 then error('expected 22 majors all met, got '..#majors..' majors / '..pairs_n..' pairs') end; local function st(a,b) return GameInfo.DiplomaticStates[Players[id[a]]:GetDiplomaticAI():GetDiplomaticStateIndex(id[b])].StateType end; local function war(a,b) return Players[id[a]]:GetDiplomacy():IsAtWarWith(id[b]) end; local function feud(a,b) local n=0; local mods=Players[id[a]]:GetDiplomaticAI():GetDiplomaticModifiers(id[b]); if mods then for _,t in ipairs(mods) do if t.Score==-10 then n=n+t.Score end end end return n end;  local s=Game:GetProperty('JAC_JAPAN_1534_RELATIONS'); if s==nil then error('relations property missing') end; if s.Applied~=16 or s.Failed~=0 or s.Missing~=0 then error('applied='..tostring(s.Applied)..' failed='..tostring(s.Failed)..' missing='..tostring(s.Missing)) end; if s.Turn~=GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn() then error('applied on turn '..tostring(s.Turn)) end; if not war('OUCHI','OTOMO') or not war('OTOMO','OUCHI') then error('R01 Ouchi-Otomo not at war') end; local allies={{'HOJO','IMAGAWA'},{'OUCHI','MORI'},{'DATE','ASHINA'},{'ASHIKAGA','ROKKAKU'},{'ASAKURA','ROKKAKU'},{'ASHIKAGA','ASAKURA'},{'AMAGO','MORI'},{'SHIMAZU','RYUKYU'}}; for _,pair in ipairs(allies) do local x,y=pair[1],pair[2]; if x>y then x,y=y,x end; if type(Game:GetProperty('JAC_1534_ALLIANCE_'..x..'-'..y))~='number' then error('start alliance '..x..'-'..y..' is not marked active') end end; for _,pair in ipairs(allies) do for _,d in ipairs({{pair[1],pair[2]},{pair[2],pair[1]}}) do local s=st(d[1],d[2]); if s~='DIPLO_STATE_ALLIED' then error(d[1]..'->'..d[2]..' state '..tostring(s)..' (expected allied)') end end end; for _,f in ipairs({'HOJO','IMAGAWA','SHIMAZU','RYUKYU'}) do local held=false; for row in GameInfo.CivilizationTraits() do if row.CivilizationType=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_'..f and row.TraitType=='TRAIT_JAC_1534_ALLY_VISION' then held=true end end; if not held then error(f..' lacks TRAIT_JAC_1534_ALLY_VISION (ally vision)') end end; local function sees(a,b) local v=PlayersVisibility[id[a]]; for _,c in Players[id[b]]:GetCities():Members() do if not v:IsVisible(c:GetX(),c:GetY()) then return false,c:GetName() end end return true end; local function seesNone(a,b) local v=PlayersVisibility[id[a]]; for _,c in Players[id[b]]:GetCities():Members() do if v:IsVisible(c:GetX(),c:GetY()) then return false,c:GetName() end end return true end; local shared=0; for _,pair in ipairs(allies) do for _,d in ipairs({{pair[1],pair[2]},{pair[2],pair[1]}}) do local ok,city=sees(d[1],d[2]); if not ok then error(d[1]..' does not see ally '..d[2]..' city center '..tostring(city)) end; local va=PlayersVisibility[id[d[1]]]; for _,u in Players[id[d[2]]]:GetUnits():Members() do shared=shared+1; if not va:IsVisible(u:GetX(),u:GetY()) then error(d[1]..' misses ally '..d[2]..' unit at '..u:GetX()..','..u:GetY()) end end end end; if shared==0 then error('allies see no plots at all') end; for _,d in ipairs({{'DATE','SHIMAZU'},{'SHIMAZU','DATE'}}) do local ok,city=seesNone(d[1],d[2]); if not ok then error('non-allied '..d[1]..' sees '..d[2]..' city center '..tostring(city)) end end; for _,pair in ipairs({{'HOJO','TAKEDA'},{'IMAGAWA','TAKEDA'},{'HOJO','YAMANOUCHI_UESUGI'},{'NAGAO','YAMANOUCHI_UESUGI'},{'NAGAO','HONGANJI'},{'HONGANJI','ROKKAKU'},{'ODA','MATSUDAIRA'}}) do for _,dd in ipairs({{pair[1],pair[2]},{pair[2],pair[1]}}) do if feud(dd[1],dd[2])~=-10 then error(dd[1]..'->'..dd[2]..' feud penalty '..tostring(feud(dd[1],dd[2]))..' (expected -10)') end end end; if war('HOJO','TAKEDA') or st('HOJO','TAKEDA')=='DIPLO_STATE_DECLARED_FRIEND' then error('feud pair Hojo-Takeda must be neither at war nor friends') end; if feud('ODA','DATE')~=0 or feud('SHIMAZU','RYUKYU')~=0 then error('unrelated or friendly pair has a feud penalty') end; if war('ODA','DATE') then error('unrelated pair Oda-Date at war') end; return 'start: 16 relations applied on the start turn; Ouchi-Otomo war; 8 ally pairs (incl. Shimazu-Ryukyu) allied, marked active and share vision (city centers and every plot the partner sees); Date-Shimazu see no city center of each other; 7 feud pairs show -10 both ways and stay at peace'
